speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked  the Minister for Manpower what constitutes claims for "wrongful" or "unfair" dismissal which will be heard by the Employment Claims Tribunal.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: So, can the ECT also recognise damages that go beyond the notice period, so that we also recognise the mental and emotional anguish that one has suffered in such situations?

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: As to what the compensation should include, it is up to the ECT to assess and that will also depend on what was presented to the Tribunal by the claimant in terms of the range of losses suffered.

speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
text: I have three supplementary questions for the Second Minister.

speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
text: Second question: whether employers should be required to give reasons when terminating the contract with notice and salary in lieu of notice.

speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
text: Third, whether MOM will consider coming up with a set of FAQs or guidelines publicly to provide more clarity and certainty as to what amounts to an unfair dismissal.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: The first is on two different sets of dismissals.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: The second set has to do with non-renewals of contracts and non-confirmation during probation.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: These are not the same at all because, in such instances, there was already an agreement that the contract would come to an end, if not renewed, or there may not be continued employment after probation.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: These two types of situations do not fall within the ambit of wrongful dismissals, but, if any contract terms were not met, then the employee can certainly bring the matter up to the Tripartite Alliance for Dispute Management.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: On the second question on whether the employer should be required to give reasons even when terminating a contract with notice or salary in lieu of notice, well, in most employment contracts, the employee may resign with notice and not provide reasons.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: They can also terminate with notice and not provide reasons.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: But this does not stop the employee from taking up the matter with MOM or the Tripartite Alliance for Dispute Management, if other contract terms were not met, or if he believed that his dismissal was wrongful in some way.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: MOM will work with our tripartite partners to do so.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: Can I just confirm that for wrongful dismissal, the ECT can recognise damages that go beyond the notice period; they do not just compensate on the one or two months' notice that they were not given?

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: It will depend on the claims of losses, in this case, that the employee puts up, and then the ECT will have to assess.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: I think it is very hard to say in the absence of facts of the case.
